{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter out refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
completed_sales = valid_sales[valid_sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter out invalid age values (customer_age == -1)
valid_ages = completed_sales[completed_sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean age of valid customers: {mean_age}")"}
